maria: Heads-up: starting v13 client migration this week. Few quick Qs: auth rotation flow changed? retries behavior for streaming in Node? breaking changes for Go client?
aj: Short answers: yes on auth change (token fallback removed), retries moved to middleware, streaming has backpressure fix but may drop small chunks. I'll post checklist.
aj: ```
1) Auth: use new rotateToken(apiKey)
2) Retries: enable client.setRetry({enabled:true, max:3})
3) Streaming Node: prefer backpressure API: stream.pause()/resume() or use batchSize tuning
4) Go: update client.New -> client.NewWithConfig
``` 
maria: Where's doc link? need exact code snippets for token rotation (python/node/go).
devex-bot: https://redwood.dev/docs/sdk/v13-migration : official migration guide (will add snippets).
liam: Go note: NewWithConfig changed Defaults() and import path -> github.com/redwood/inference/sdk-go/v3. Vendoring may break. Quick fix:
liam: `go get github.com/redwood/inference/sdk-go/v3@v3.0.0`
liam: Also watch context signature: many funcs now accept context.Context explicitly.
tara: Node streaming: saw ERR_STREAM_DESTROYED when piping fetch -> client.stream. Workaround: use AbortController and pass {signal} to client.stream; v13.1.1 patches this.
aj: I'll open PR to docs and add migration snippets + compatibility table. Ping me for code review: PR #4823
maria: :thumbsup: I'll run migration on staging Thurs. Who wants to review runtime tests?
liam: I can run Go e2e.
tara: I'll do Node smoke tests.
sre-bot: scheduled deploy: runtime patch v2026-03-20 - expect brief reconnects during rolling update.
maria: Thanks all, will drop results in #devex after staging run.
